items.title: Mcbee interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: I played my first gig with Jimmy “Cry Cry,” with — standing on his head... This was before James Brown.

ctx.x: Aluminum bass. And so I tried to play something and, tried to play some boogie woogie on it like I had heard on the juke box. And so a couple of days later I got some buddies to join me and we would try to play some boogie woogie or something you know. There was a trombone player, saxophone player, and there was a drummer. No piano player. So we had a good time. And then a couple of months later we were in the same room. Somebody knocks on the door. And Wesley, my buddy, alto player, who was a star forward for…

early October. The window was out. There was a towel to prevent the wind from coming in. I played my first gig with Jimmy “Cry Cry,” with — standing on his head. This was before James Brown. He would stand on his head literally crying while he would hold the mic — he would support his body with his right hand and hold the mic literally upside down, crying ‘cause his baby left him. Right? That was my first gig.
